facts: $A=\pi r^{2}+\pi r l$: the base circle $\pi r^{2}$ plus the curved surface $\pi r l$.
$\pi r l$ alone is the **curved (lateral) surface area** — use it for an **open** cone such as a party hat.
$l$ is the **slant height**, not the perpendicular height; if only $h$ is given, find $l=\sqrt{r^{2}+h^{2}}$ first.
When a **diameter** is given, halve it to get $r$ before substituting.
Leave a multiple of $\pi$ for an exact answer; round only the final line.
steps: Write the formula, finding the slant height first if it is not given.
Substitute $r$ and $l$, halving a diameter first.
Evaluate, leaving $\pi$ or rounding as asked.

foundation.solution_text:
First halve the diameter: $r=16\div2=8\text{ cm}$.
$A=\pi r^{2}+\pi rl$
$=\pi(8)^{2}+\pi(8)(13)$
$=64\pi+104\pi$
$=168\pi$
$\approx527.8\text{ cm}^{2}$

First halve the diameter: $r=18\div2=9\text{ cm}$.
$A=\pi r^{2}+\pi rl$
$=\pi(9)^{2}+\pi(9)(11)$
$=81\pi+99\pi$
$=180\pi\text{ cm}^{2}$

For an open cone use only the curved surface, $\pi rl$.
$A=\pi rl$
$=\pi(5)(12)$
$=60\pi$
$\approx188.5\text{ cm}^{2}$

For an open cone use only the curved surface, $\pi rl$.
$A=\pi rl$
$=\pi(4)(9)$
$=36\pi\text{ cm}^{2}$

development.question_text:
The curved surface area of a cone is $400\text{ cm}^{2}$ and its base radius is $5\text{ cm}$.
Find the slant height, correct to $1$ decimal place.
development.solution_text:
The curved surface area is $\pi rl$.
$400=\pi\times5\times l$
$l=\dfrac{400}{5\pi}$
$=25.4647\ldots$
$\approx25.5\text{ cm}$

development.question_text:
A cone has a curved surface area of $60\pi\text{ cm}^{2}$ and a slant height of $12\text{ cm}$.
Find its base radius.
development.solution_text:
The curved surface area is $\pi rl$.
$60\pi=\pi\times r\times12$
$60=12r$
$r=5\text{ cm}$

A cone has a base area of $150\text{ cm}^{2}$ and a total surface area of $500\text{ cm}^{2}$.
Find its base radius and slant height, each correct to $1$ decimal place.
mastery.solution_text:
$\pi r^{2}=150$
$r=\sqrt{\dfrac{150}{\pi}}$
$=6.9098\ldots$
$\approx6.9\text{ cm}$
Curved surface: $500-150=350$
$\pi rl=350$
$l=\dfrac{350}{\pi\times6.9098\ldots}$
$=16.1231\ldots$
$\approx16.1\text{ cm}$
